illustration.description: Full-page woodcut Evangelist portrait plate of St. Luke (ቅዱስ ሉቃስ) on page ፫፻፹፫ (383). St. Luke is depicted seated on an ornate chair with a halo, resting his head thoughtfully on his left hand and holding a quill in his right hand over an open Gospel book on his lap. Beside him reclines his traditional evangelical symbol, the winged ox (calf). Above his head is the Holy Spirit in the form of a dove and a crown/halo band bearing a tiny inscription. The circular medallion is framed by eight elaborate Ethiopian interlacing foliate/harag ornaments at the corners and cardinal points.
